action_log_retry_key_unique.name: action_log_retry_key_unique
action_log_retry_key_unique.where: "action_log"."retry_key" is not null and "action_log"."status" = 'succeeded' and not "action_log"."dry_run"

actors_user_required.name: actors_user_required
actors_user_required.value: "actors"."kind" not in ('staff', 'agent') or "actors"."user_id" is not null

runs_retry_key_unique.name: runs_retry_key_unique
runs_retry_key_unique.where: "runs"."retry_key" is not null and "runs"."status" = 'succeeded' and not "runs"."dry_run"
